summary.lv: AS Kesko Senukai Latvia meklē IT projektu vadītāju ar 2–5 gadu pieredzi IT vai ERP projektu vadībā, kurš plānos, vadīs un koordinēs IT projektus, nodrošinot to izpildi atbilstoši termiņiem un budžetam.
summary.en: AS Kesko Senukai Latvia is looking for an IT project manager with 2–5 years of experience in IT or ERP project management to plan, lead, and coordinate IT projects within schedule and budget.
